company.shortDescription: Unmannd, a defence technology startup building next-generation autonomous drone systems.
company.description: Founded in February 2025 by Yeshwanth Reddy and Hemaditya Prasad, Unmannd is developing systems for the future of defence logistics and aerial security. Its first product, Titan, is a heavy-duty drone designed to carry and deliver supplies.
